8 · Primary vs Secondary filter style

Primary (primaryFilter = true): used for top-level filters — transparent with teal border, fills teal when active. Secondary (primaryFilter = false): used for sub-filters — no border, appears already selected (pre-filtered), teal text.

Primary Date Range Last 30 days Status 2Departments 3Users
